notes:
1. Capsule-Style Executive UI: Redesigned navigation, action bars, filter bars, and status badges into modern capsule pills.
2. Returns & Adjustments Engine: Dedicated Returns module for Sales Returns (Credit Notes) & Purchase Returns (Debit Notes) with live stock tally and automated double-entry vouchers.
3. Intelligent Data Import Suite: Tesseract OCR invoice scanner with auto field extraction, Bulk Excel/CSV column-mapping wizard, and Bank/UPI statement reconciler.
4. Enterprise Storage & Architecture: DAO Repository abstraction layer, automated v2 migration engine with safety snapshots, and PBKDF2/AES-GCM WebCrypto security.
5. Automated Safeguards: Scheduled daily backup (21:00) & cash drawer closing backup, interactive PIN-protected backup restore screen, and append-only audit trail ledger.
